svg.title: History's three piles: one failed write, three conclusions, three traces
svg.desc: Top: a write history makes for a shard fails with one of the six error names the server's fault injector takes, and history sorts the store's answer into one of three piles, each with what it does next (read in server v1.31.0's source, not run: service/history/shard/context_impl.go:1443-1469 and :1189-1233). Under each pile, what its rauns left while the fault held: the injector at 1% on UpdateWorkflowExecution at 20 workflows/s on server 1.31.0, on the lab host, an m8i.8xlarge, each panel saying how many rauns it read. Bottom: the control, two restarts of history with no fault, and Unavailable, which the persistence client retries. Sources: cells/compose/config/laug-server.yaml, docs/img/src/three-piles.txt, docs/tables/rauns.jsonl, docs/tables/src/hosts.tsv, faults/catalog.yaml.

svg.text: Unavailable takes the third pile's branch, but the persistence client retries it once, 40 to 50 ms later, so history
rarely sees it (source: common/persistence/client/factory.go:270-278, common/util.go:39-40, server v1.31.0).
Rauns of boot 6 on the lab host, an m8i.8xlarge; the figure's desc names each raun's file.
